export_policy: Completed blocks and both runs' metadata/scripts/cleanup are preserved byte for byte. Incomplete initial auto-custom block, fixture data and executable bytes are omitted. Historical absolute paths inside captured records are cache-relative provenance, not portable links.
orchestration_failure: The initial auto-generic block completed and stopped cleanly. The next block failed a safe bind check on a reused port. Continuation used distinct ports and completed auto-custom and the separate instrumented phase pass. The initial root run is not a successful full run.
audit_scope: verify.py checks exported hashes, independently regenerates the deterministic fixture digest, parses every completed block's result/resource records, recomputes summaries, verifies counters/settings/runtime metadata and phase arithmetic, and checks recorded cleanup. Executable bytes and live cleanup require separate local inspection. It runs no benchmarks or gates.
limits: Forced-mode differences include Param/Const bounds and folding, so mode deltas cannot isolate planning CPU.
PGSS times are instrumented elapsed time; execution includes planning. Span-entry plans counts are not rebuild counts. Phase totals include warmup and exclude Parse/Describe setup.
This is neither an engine optimization nor a PostgreSQL comparison or recommendation to force generic plans in production.
Prior build provenance limitations remain; the diagnostic records live executable hashes but does not reconstruct compiler invocations.
Warm 200000-row checked read fixture; no sustained-write or memory-efficiency claim.
